Package org.geysermc.paletter.data

Interface PaletteDataSource

public interface PaletteDataSource
Supplies vanilla data to a Paletter. bundled() reads the data shipped inside the library jar, so no network access or external files are needed at runtime; directory(Path) reads the same format from a directory, e.g. data refreshed for a newer Bedrock version than the library bundles.

This is a closed set of sources: the loading contract is internal.

Since:
1.0.0
